name: Wes Nakai
line: Started as a boatman in '04 and has not missed a season since. Reads water two rapids ahead and calls it out loud so you learn to see it too.

name: Marisol Ortega
line: Trains every guide we hire, which is why our safety talk sounds the same whichever boat you draw. Teaches the paddle command before she teaches the stroke.

name: Dewey Hartman
line: Runs the biggest water we offer and the only guide who will tell you a trip is above your level. Also the one who packs the extra dry bag.

name: Priya Raman
line: Came down from the kayak side and still paddles every run she guides before the season opens. The person to ask if you want to learn to roll.
